purpose: Paths the public export leaves behind. Backlog task 167 reads this file and drops every matching path from the archive it publishes; tests/export-exclusions.test.mjs proves the list covers what it claims to cover. A directory entry ends with a slash and matches on a segment boundary, never as a bare prefix. A keep entry wins over every exclusion.
